sources.title: GitHub - VinAIResearch/PhoWhisper: PhoWhisper: Automatic Speech ...
sources.snippet: We introduce PhoWhisper in five versions for Vietnamese automatic speech recognition. PhoWhisper's robustness is achieved through fine-tuning the multilingual Whisper on an 844-hour dataset that encompasses diverse Vietnamese accents.

sources.title: PhoWhisper-medium Open-source Speech Recognition Model - Free ...
sources.snippet: PhoWhisper is a series of models designed specifically for Vietnamese automatic speech recognition (ASR). It achieves high robustness by fine-tuning the Whisper model on an 844-hour Vietnamese accent dataset.
